claims: Bosnia and Herzegovina defeated Italy 4-1 on penalties (1-1 after extra time) on March 31, 2026, in a FIFA World Cup UEFA playoff final in Zenica.
Haris Tabaković scored in the 79th minute for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Haris Tabaković equalized for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Moise Kean scored in the 15th minute for Italy.
The venue was Stadion Bilino Polje, Zenica.
Italy defender Alessandro Bastoni was sent off in the 41st minute.
Bosnia and Herzegovina converted all four attempts in the penalty shootout.
Pio Esposito missed for Italy in the penalty shootout.
Bryan Cristante missed for Italy in the penalty shootout.
Bosnia and Herzegovina qualifies for the 2026 World Cup.
Italy fails to qualify for the 2026 World Cup.
Italy failed to qualify for the 2018 World Cup.
Italy failed to qualify for the 2022 World Cup.
